data.body: Plan-review attempt-2 returned 2 genuine BLOCKs (push/delete ordering contradiction; crash invariant). Both remediated by verifying helper source: cmd_push rejects at bundles>1 BEFORE any write, and a bundle is a plain 'git bundle create' at {prefix}/{ref}/{sha}.bundle. Corrected to crash-safe ordering: acquire helper lock -> re-enumerate (TOCTOU) -> fetch heads -> lossless multi-parent merge T -> put_object T as NEW bundle (durability barrier, nothing deleted yet) -> delete the N originals (never T) -> init_remote_head -> release+cleanup. Guarantees >=1 bundle with full merged history at every crash point. Also took advisories: conflict-path test+AC, fixed _GITATTRIBUTES ref to init.py:55, scratch-ref cleanup, structured log record, pinned git_remote_s3 v0.3.2 API surface via the live canary.
